integrity: Both sharp classifications are proved by symbolic chamber and coarea arguments; standalone finite computations corroborate but do not establish infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted real paths, full four-site central-spacing windows; no cyclic or larger-window generalization claimed.
source_date_evidence: 2009-04-16 posting is explicitly stated in Celebi et al. 2009 full-text publication header; later publication was 2009-05-29.
title: Sharp one-input versus two-input variation thresholds for sliding four-point central spacings
